== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A [[Naraka]] Gate is a [[portal]] that serves as an opening between the primary world and a specific [[Territory]]. These gateways function as fast travel routes or waypoints, allowing individuals to move between different locations and realms. Opening a Gate can be a difficult process that requires significant focus, energy, and time; for instance, some individuals may require nearly a minute to manifest one. Certain [[Gates]], such as those leading to [[Elysia]], are subject to specific limitations, including being restricted to once per day and only during daylight hours. Navigating through a Gate can be physically taxing, often leaving travelers covered in ash or smoke. While they provide essential transit, they are also vulnerable to being forced open shortly after closing by specialized entities known as gatecrawlers, which are used to track [[Travelers]] into foreign territories. Additionally, [[Gates]] can only be opened at specific designated points, as attempting to manifest one in the wrong location can be fatal. While some travelers work together to hold a Gate steady, others possess the ability to seal them shut or manipulate waypoints to prevent pursuit.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Naraka]] Gate is a specific location that can be opened. While the gate is held open by two [[Naraka Traveler|Naraka Travelers]], [[Indirial]] turns toward it and [[Leah]] walks in its direction. Eventually, the gate opens to release a screaming orange fireball from the depths of the [[Territory]]. Following this event, people are seen scrambling out of the gate behind [[Grandmaster Naraka]].}}
